{{Top|leg}}
'''Bolton''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Bolton falsified the cargo manifests of [[DC5-1]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], knowing that [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] officials tended to believe the manifests without checking. Bolton passed on the advice to fellow subscribers of the Datalog.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
